description: A screen-time dashboard with stacked category bars, a week and day toggle, and a list of most used apps.
overview: Bars stack social, productivity and entertainment time. A `ToggleGroup` switches between a weekly view and an hourly view of one day. In the week view, touching a bar selects that day through `onActiveIndexChange`, dims the other days and updates the headline, comparison text, category totals and the most used apps list below. A dashed line marks the weekly average. The bars set `isAnimationActive={false}`, so they draw without the enter animation and switch views instantly.
usage: Replace `USAGE` with daily minutes per category and `APPS` with your apps and their share of each category. The hourly view is generated from `PROFILE`, so swap `hourly()` for real data. The component takes no props.
